title: Cooking Without Power
description: Compares indoor-safe options (Sterno, fondue pots, camp stoves with caution) with outdoor grills, campfires, rocket stoves, and solar cookers, including a DIY solar oven. Covers fuel storage and retained-heat cooking, carbon monoxide and fire safety, and four simple emergency recipes.
shortDescription: Indoor-safe heat, grills, rocket and solar stoves, and fuel-saving tips
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
